_about: Exceptions to the design lint (tools/agents/design-lint.mjs, D-533), each with its reason: none is silent. Entries { file, rule, what, reason }: `rule` is one of token-colour, colour, radius, space, copied, text-size or `*`; `what` matches the hit's declaration (`color: #ff8a8a`) or selector, `*` matching any run of characters. An entry that no longer hits fails design-lint.test.mjs as stale, so remove it when the stylesheet changes. The human-readable side is docs/DESIGN.md §4.

entries.reason: the chat bubble's tail: a 4 px corner is a shape (where the bubble points), not a size on the corner scale
reserves the install bubble's height under the page while it floats (D-232): the size of another element, not rhythm
room for the install bubble's ✕ (44 px, absolutely positioned) beside the text: the size of another element, not rhythm
room for the install bubble's ✕ beside the button from 480 px: the size of another element, not rhythm
the podium step (.escalon): flat 4 px feet so the three steps read as one podium; a shape, not a size on the scale
the speech bubble's tail (.cs-globo), the same 4 px tail as base.css's chat bubble; a shape, not a size on the scale
The word's letters on the board (`.word .ch`): the game's own size, between the title steps and the text steps, chosen so a long word fits at 320 px (C-8).
The word's letters when the word is long (`.word.long .ch`) and the theme card's emoji: the board's own sizes.
The word's letters on a short screen (`.word .ch` under 780 px tall): the board's own size.
The revealed word on the verdict's card (`.verdict .word-big span`): the board's own size.
The deck card's emoji (`.theme-card .em`), the same card and size as Ahorcado's theme card: a board's own size, between the text steps and the title steps; the card is a candidate shell component.
The solo score (`.puntos b`): a figure the player reads at a glance, the board's own size above the text steps (D-30: figures in --font-num).

The hero's emoji at two moments the shell's 4.2 rem does not fit (C-8): the cover's icon on a short phone (under 600 px tall), so the Número / Palabra toggle and the first mode stay above the fold at 320×568 (landing-fold.mjs), and the solo result's trophy, so the score, the card and the final buttons fit without scrolling. Between the shell's size and the text steps: a hero's own size, not a text step.
The kept-die tag (`.dado-btn .tag`, "Guardado") under each of five dice: the board's own size, so the word fits under a 50 px die at 320 px (C-8); the smallest text step overflows it.
The rivals' dice drawn as glyphs (`.rivals .rival .d`): five of them must fit in the rival card's 74 px, under the smallest text step; a board's own size.
The bid's figure (`.bid-chip b` and its kin): a number the table reads from across the phone, the board's own size above the text steps (D-30: figures in --font-num).
